notes: One dated table of order rules for Indian markets. Rows are data: the evaluator in flinttrade_core.order_rules applies them the same way for the order ticket, Practice, backtests and the order API. authority orders the rows (regulatory, exchange, broker, then FlintTrade's own product rules). level is what the operator sees: block refuses the order, warn lets it through with a note, info explains what will happen. message is shown verbatim after its placeholders are filled. Rows that share a family are alternatives: the first matching row in file order wins. A rule that is not confirmed is not listed here, or is listed as info. Lot sizes stay in the instrument master and charges stay in indian_charges.json. How a broker attaches a stop-loss and target is the broker capability profile.

rules.description: Stop-loss market orders are not allowed on options. Use stop-loss limit.
rules.message: Stop-market isn't available for options; use stop-limit.

rules.description: FlintTrade never sends a stop-loss market order on an option, on any exchange.
rules.message: Stop-market isn't available for options; use stop-limit.

rules.description: FlintTrade never sends a plain market order on an option. Every option order carries a limit price.
rules.message: Market orders aren't accepted on options. Use a limit price.

rules.description: API market orders in F&O are sent as limit orders with price protection and may not fill in a fast market.
rules.message: Market orders in F&O are not accepted — use a limit price.

rules.description: Market orders are allowed only on contracts that have traded during the day.
rules.message: This contract hasn't traded today — use a limit price.

rules.description: On BSE the stop-loss limit price must be within a set gap of the trigger price.
rules.message: Stop-loss limit must be within ₹{max_gap} of trigger.

rules.description: NSE options trade within a daily operating range. Prices outside it are rejected.
rules.message: Enter a price within ₹{low}–₹{high}.

rules.description: On SENSEX expiry day the price protection range for low-priced options narrows to ₹10.
rules.message: Price may be outside the exchange band (₹{low}–₹{high}).

rules.description: BSE rejects limit orders outside its price protection range.
rules.message: Price may be outside the exchange band (₹{low}–₹{high}).

rules.description: NSE rejects option limit orders priced too far from the last traded price.
rules.message: Price may be outside the exchange band (₹{low}–₹{high}).

rules.description: Up to 10 orders per second per exchange. Higher rates need exchange registration.
rules.message: Wait a moment — the limit is {max_per_second} orders per second per exchange.

rules.description: Live API trading requires a client undertaking to the broker that the strategy is self-built. Losses from its logic are outside the exchange grievance process.
rules.message: Orders will be sent from this computer through your broker account. Losses from your own strategy or automation aren't covered by the exchange grievance process.

rules.description: Kotak rejects market orders on contracts with no traded price for the day.
rules.message: This contract hasn't traded today — use a limit price.

rules.description: Dhan limits orders to 10 per second, 250 per minute, 1,000 per hour and 7,000 per day, with 25 modifications per order.
rules.message: Wait {wait} — the limit is {limit} orders per {window}.

rules.description: Dhan accepts at most 25 changes to one order.
rules.message: This order has already been modified {limit} times — place a new order.

rules.description: Dhan sends market orders, including triggered Super Order legs, as limit orders within about 10% of the last price.
rules.message: Market orders are sent as limits near the last price and may not fill.

rules.description: Kotak sends market orders as limit orders within a protection band of the last price.
rules.message: Market orders are sent as limits within about {band} of the last price and may not fill.

rules.description: Dhan squares off open intraday F&O positions from 15:25.
rules.message: Intraday F&O positions are closed from {square_off_from} — exit before then.

rules.description: Practice and backtests fill a market order only within 3% of the last price. A market order on an option in a backtest becomes a limit at that cap.
rules.message: Practice fills a market order only within {cap_pct}% of the last price.

rules.description: Brokers without attached orders get the stop-loss and target as separate orders.
rules.message: Stop-loss and target are placed as separate orders with this broker.
